newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish stocks down on profit-taking sales.
newsitem.headline: Turkish stocks down on profit-taking sales.

text.p: Shares prices at Istanbul's stock exchange opened lower on Friday on profit-taking sales despite earlier market expectations that shares might rise at the market's opening on fading political worries.
The IMKB National-100 was down 1.5 percent at 1,447 at 0730 GMT.
Traders said lack of fresh positive news led some investors to sell their shares after Thursday's sharp rise of 2.94 percent.
